name: Flavor Compounds
desc: Compounds are must-haves in your cupboard. They make your food and beverage taste “fuller,” introducing complex notes that resemble the nuances of the flavor they’re derived from, blending complexity, concentration, and customization into one powerful ingredient. Crafted carefully using natural and organic materials, our flavor compounds are applied in various products, which serves to elevate the taste, aroma, or even the texture of food, beverages, cosmetics, etc. without the health-adverse synthetic additives, artificial colors, and preservatives.

name: Flavor Concentrates
desc: Our powerful flavor concentrates are infused to bring out a delightful and delicious taste in recipes without altering texture or consistency. As our potent flavor concentrates are water-based and emulsified with gum arabic, it will bring out an intense flavor that could withstand the heat, making them ideal for beverage, baked goods, frozen desserts, sauces and syrups. Flavor extracts on the other hand, are alcohol-based, which make them the best flavorings to use in making drinks. Our natural and organic liquid concentrates are made with real plant-based materials, capturing the true essence of nature.

name: Flavor Emulsions
desc: For recipes that require high heat exposure and a water-based flavoring, you will need to use flavor emulsions. These emulsions allow flavor to remain stable and consistent throughout production and shelf life, making them a preferred solution for food manufacturers and home bakers alike. Our flavor emulsions provide the performance, stability, and clean-label quality to help bring your culinary vision to life.

name: Flavor Extract
desc: Enhance the taste of your baked goods, drinks, and desserts with our premium-quality organic and natural flavor extracts. Choose from hundreds of flavors to find your favorites.

name: Flavor Oils
desc: Crafted for oil-based applications, our natural and organic flavor oils for lip balm offer a bold, clean, and concentrated taste. Since they are formulated to fulfill clean-label standards, they are made with high quality natural or USDA-certified ingredients, resulting in a potent oil packaged to provide you with rich flavorings for your products where water-soluble extracts or emulsions won’t work.

name: Flavor Powders
desc: Our flavor powders are perfect for adding to baking mixes, giving your baked goods additional flavor, and taking your desserts to a whole new level. You can also add our natural flavor powders to drinks to sweeten and flavor. Use a natural powder flavoring for baking in any of your favorite recipes. Our flavor powders can be added to dry ingredients when baking cakes, bread, muffins, pies, and cookies. Add flavor to culinary dishes, and use our natural flavoring powders to create marinades, soups, stews, and sauces. You can also add our natural flavored powders to enhance the flavor profile of your protein powder. Enhance beverages like hot chocolate, mixed drinks, and lemonades with our natural powder flavorings. Use natural fruit-flavored powders to add a fruity taste to smoothies and pastries.

name: Flavored Decaf Coffee
desc: Flavored decaf coffee is the perfect option for anyone who loves coffee but needs to avoid caffeine. These coffees also work well in cold brew or iced formats, offering a smooth, flavorful sip even in chilled beverages. For best results, use filtered water and adjust grind and brew time based on your method of choice to bring out the full character of each blend.

name: Flavored Syrups
desc: Nature’s Flavors formulated flavored syrups with natural and certified organic ingredients in the hopes of delivering vibrant and bold tastes that not only nourish, but also meet the highest standards of clean-label formulation. Our flavored syrups fulfill clean-label demands, perfect for cafes and restaurants who are looking to create more healthful and delicious food menu items.

name: Flavoring for Lip Balm
desc: At Nature's Flavors, our flavor experts have created lip balm flavor oils with natural or organic flavor oils that are safe for use on delicate lips. These flavoring oils for lip gloss are great for adding scents to lip balms and more lip products. Feel free to experiment and customize them with your favorite scent. You can create your own natural lip gloss with our flavor oils for lip balms with a few ingredients: coconut oil, beeswax, and your favorite lip gloss flavor oil. Melt the beeswax, add the coconut oil, and mix them together. Then, add your favorite lip flavor oil. Simply pour the mixture into a container, and allow it to cool for at least ten minutes.

name: Flavorings for Coffee and Tea
desc: As part of our extracts and flavorings, we offer flavorings for tea and coffee. Some of the top-selling flavors of our gourmet flavorings for coffee and tea include papaya, panettone, black walnut, almond, blueberry, hazelnut, bergamot, pumpkin spice, corn, vanilla, tiramisu, pinenut, peach, cardamom, acai, Irish cream, and chocolate mint. Browse our entire selection of flavorings for coffee and tea for even more delicious flavors. If you have a flavor idea, let us know, and we can help you create a custom flavoring for coffee and tea.

name: Flavorings for Water
desc: Our natural water flavorings are an excellent way to zazz up your water, making sure you hit your recommended daily water intake and stay hydrated. Our delicious flavorings for water are also great substitutes for sugary sodas, lattes, juices, and more. These flavored water drops transform ordinary water into a tasty beverage that you’ll want to drink every day. Enjoy a refreshing glass of water with our all-natural water flavorings now.

name: Flavors without Diacetyl
desc: Diacetyl-free flavors refer to extracts, emulsions, oils, and other flavorings that do not use a widely speculated health-adverse chemical called Diacetyl (more commonly found in pop corn) during its formulation. Flavorings that are non-diacetyl instead rely on natural and USDA-certified organic ingredients to create the irresistible flavor notes that people love. Our diacetyl-free flavors are crafted to give you peace of mind and great tasting products, no matter if you’re developing a popcorn seasoning, a nutty cream sauce, or a clean-label creamy dessert.

name: Food and Beverage Ingredients
desc: Crafted with intentionally-sourced ingredients without artificial preservatives, deliver the pure and vibrant flavors of fruit glazes and decadent compounds meant to be in natural sweeteners, toppings, and organic food colorings. Every product is designed to bring out the best in your food and beverage applications.

name: Food Coloring
desc: Nature's Flavors uses a variety of premium raw materials to manufacture our natural and organic food colors. This includes beets, turmeric root, annatto seeds, purple carrot, purple cabbage, gardenia flowers, hibiscus flowers, grape skin, and many more. Our food dye is made using only all-natural and organic plant extracts, which have been shown to be high in bioflavonoids, polyphenols, and antioxidants. These are all active, beneficial additives to you and your children's diet.

name: Fragrance Emulsions
desc: Available as USDA certified organic fragrance emulsions as well, you can add these scented fragrance extracts to your organic skincare and body care products. These water-soluble fragrance emulsions give beauty cosmetics, bath products, and candles a long-lasting aroma, as they help to evenly distribute the scent throughout the product.

name: Fragrance Oils
desc: Our fragrance oils are excellent aromatic oils that are used in a variety of applications. Premium fragrance oils are often highly concentrated and can be diluted with a carrier oil to reduce the potency and make the oil safe for skincare, body care, and hair care applications.

name: Fragrance Powders
desc: Nature’s Flavors fragrance powders are designed for easy incorporation into your formulations, allowing you to enhance your products with ease and consistency. Whether you're a small batch artisan or a large-scale manufacturer, our fragrance powders provide a reliable and effective way to add a natural, beautiful fragrance to your creations, leaving a lasting impression with every use.

name: Fragrances
desc: An oil is essential because it carries a distinctive scent or essence, of the plant it is extracted from. Although they are generally extracted by distillation, other processes may be utilized including expression or solvent extraction. These natural fragrances and essential oils can be used in perfumes, cosmetics, soaps, and household cleaning products, as well as for flavoring foods and drinks and adding scents to incense, candles, and other products.

name: DFB adidas 125th Anniversary Range
desc: Celebrate 125 years of the DFB, and its long association with the 3-Stripes. Inspired by iconic adidas shirts that came before it, this football jersey has subtle pinstripes and a tonal eagle engineered into its soft jacquard fabric. Moisture-managing AEROREADY keeps players and fans comfortable. A sign-off above the hem nods to the plaque commemorating the DFB's foundation in Leipzig. This product is made with 100% recycled materials. By reusing materials that have already been created, we help to reduce waste and our reliance on finite resources and reduce the footprint of the products we make.

name: PSG X Jordan Wings Fourth Kit Collection 2024-25

name: Everton Hummel Away Shirt 2023-24
desc: From kickoff to the final whistle make sure you're playing in true Blue fashion for every moment of the action with the official Everton Away kit for the 2023-24 season. The 2023-24 away shirt draws inspiration from the colours and vertical stripes of the 92-94 strip and the striking pattern of the 94-96 shirts. Incorporating these eras of Everton's history make this season's shirt a fitting tribute to the club's heritage and a must-have for fans whether you were there for those bygone matches or you're too young to remember them. The team crest and hummel logo are featured on the chest, and the famous silhouette of the Everton Tower is on the back neck. The shirt is made with hummel's ECO8 technology, incorporating material from up to 8 plastic bottles and ensuring that minimal water is used during the dyeing process.

name: Wonders of Sri Lanka
desc: From the golden shores of Colombo to the misty highlands of Nuwara Eliya and the wild landscapes of Yala, experience the many faces of Sri Lanka on this unforgettable journey. Climb the UNESCO-listed Sigiriya Rock Fortress, explore the sacred temples of Kandy and Anuradhapura, and meet a practicing monk for a traditional blessing ceremony. Watch Asian elephants roam freely on safari in Yala National Park, then journey to the colonial streets of Galle Fort, where Dutch-era mansions overlook the Indian Ocean. Along the way, visit a working tea estate, enjoy high tea at the Grand Hotel and witness the skill of Weligama’s stilt fishermen. With amazing landscapes, rich traditions and warm hospitality at every turn, discover the Pearl of the Indian Ocean on a trip to Sri Lanka.

name: NEW! ICOES Digital Certificate
desc: Affiliates will get a 30% pay out on each sale of the ICOES Digital Certificate. This certificate from the International Council for Online Educational Standards (ICOES), is issued in PDF format. It includes the ICOES logo and advisory board signature and is personalised with the student's name, the name of the course they have completed, the date of completion, and grade. This is not a standalone item and should only be purchased in conjunction with an International Open Academy course.

name: CPD Certified Special Needs Bundle
desc: There is always a demand for talented, caring teachers with a background in special education; upgrade your teaching skills in this growing area with the Special Needs Bundle. Get access to all five of our Special Needs related courses, including Speech & Language Specialist, Special Educational Needs, Autism Awareness, Dyslexia Awareness, and ADHD Awareness. Whether you're looking to advance your career, or work better with someone with special needs in your life, these courses are packed with information to help you recognize signs and characteristics of neurodivergence and aid these people in managing their disabilities. Start making a difference in the lives of those with special needs by signing up today.

name: Side Hustle Ideas for Starting Your New Business
